I usually don’t leave a review but I felt the need to do it because this app is really my daily day to use. It help me to keep track of my routines and habits well enough as someone with ADHD and I love it!

app_name: ADHD Habit Tracker, To Do List
title: LOVE!!  Saved my exams
body:
So so so so helpful, really has helped my procrastination. Helps me visualise my achievements for the week and helps improve my motivation, especially when I’m only 1/2 hours behind my weekly goal. 

A very very very helpful update however would be when inputting the time spent on the task you offered a ‘stopwatch option’ , that you could either a) set it so when you go off the app, your progress is wiped ( to stop procrastination as well as making it absolutely accurate with amount of time spent) or b) a stopwatch you can pause and start to get the time right, as I often do not spend big chunks of time doing work and inputting the time is frustrating. But despite that I love it!!! Wouldn’t use anything else, and it’s in no way a problem there isn’t a stopwatch, but the app would have everything I need in one if it did have this. Please consider :) thank you!!!!

app_name: ADHD Habit Tracker, To Do List
title: Life changing App
body:
This app has become an essential part of my life. A simple, yet powerful way of sticking to & keeping track of daily habits. I open the app first thing in the morning to see what regular tasks need to be completed e.g. teepee, take medication, etc. I then open the app a few times a day to tick off completed tasks & see what’s remaining. 

The UI is clear and easy to use. You can choose how regularly or on what days a task needs to be completed on e.g. Mondays & Wednesdays. There’s some very handy stats. I like to check how many times a task has been completed over its lifetime and my best streaks. 

Granted, I’m not successful at completing all tasks every single day. This is dependent on my willpower, however this tool has definitely helped me form regular habits. 5/5.

i.e. the ability to log sessions into daily/weekly goals when forgetting press ‘start/play’ on the app.

The only other thing i’d like to mention is that I can’t seem to sync my phone app with my ipad app.  Am I to buy the app again on a different device or will this be resolved?

Thanks for such a helpful app!

Keep safe and keep on keeping on.
